hints.title: Difference Array Framing
hints.text: Define diff[i] = target[i] - nums[i]. Each range addition/subtraction corresponds to adding plus or minus one to a contiguous subarray of diff.

hints.title: Sign Boundary Independence
hints.text: Positive differences require increment operations while negative differences require decrement operations. Subarrays of same sign can share operations.

hints.title: Contour Increment Rule
hints.text: Within a contiguous same-sign segment, whenever magnitude increases beyond the previous magnitude, pay the difference. If signs switch, pay the full current magnitude.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass over the difference array.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array can even be computed on the fly for O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Generalizes the classic minimum-operations-to-form-subarrays problem to signed differences.
